parallel.requirements: The parallel parent recognized the full Flasky social blogging scope, installable packaging requirement, public exports, API surface, and evaluator-sensitive canonical strings such as the anonymous homepage containing Stranger.
parallel.plan_and_ownership: The parent retained implementation ownership while spawning children for reference models, views/API behavior, and config/templates; this created useful reference coverage but also shared-workspace overlap.
parallel.implementation: The implementation path converged on canonical Flasky behavior: upstream-derived models, auth, main and API blueprints, templates, packaging metadata, tests, and a late follow API completion pass.
parallel.integration_and_delivery: The parent integrated child findings, inspected side-agent workspace overlap, reconciled packaging/export details, and delivered a complete workspace with Flasky modules and support files.
parallel.verification: Parallel verification used the Flasky-style local test suite and reached 34 passed with 1 skipped before the current official evaluation passed all 34 tests.
parallel.unfinished_or_incorrect: No official unresolved implementation gap remained; the adverse item was a coordination cost from shared source/workspace overlap that the parent reconciled.

serial.requirements: The serial run recognized the same full Flasky scope and built authentication, posts, comments, following, REST APIs, packaging, templates, and migration scaffolding.
serial.plan_and_ownership: A single agent owned the entire build end to end, with no delegation, no child handoffs, and no shared-workspace concurrency boundaries.
serial.implementation: The serial implementation was a custom Flasky-like project rather than a reference-backed reconstruction, adding pragmatic route, model, API, and template behavior from scratch.
serial.integration_and_delivery: The serial agent assembled the file tree, packaging, migrations, templates, static assets, and final project files in one workspace without cross-agent integration.
serial.verification: Serial verification covered compileall plus targeted smoke checks for app creation, auth, posts, comments, follow/timeline, and several JSON API endpoints, but not the canonical Flasky test suite.
serial.unfinished_or_incorrect: The current official evaluation failed 5 of 34 tests, consistent with evaluator-sensitive canonical behavior missing despite local smoke checks passing.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel recognized the full prompt scope and used reference children to align exact Flasky behaviors, packaging, exports, and expected strings.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial recognized the same broad scope and implemented a complete custom Flasky-like application.
comparison_dimensions.difference: The requirement difference was not broad feature awareness; it was that parallel pursued canonical hidden-test-sensitive Flasky details while serial satisfied the spec more generically.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel split reference gathering across model, views/API, and config/template children while the parent owned implementation and final integration.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial kept all implementation, integration, verification, and closure work in one agent with no child ownership boundaries.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel gained specialized canonical reference knowledge at the cost of a shared-state overlap; serial avoided coordination risk but had less evaluator-aligned reference coverage.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child handoffs returned concrete canonical app factory, config, template strings, API payloads, and model expectations that the parent consumed.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial relied on the prompt and local reasoning; there were no child briefs or handoffs and no cross-agent interface contracts.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had richer contextual interface facts for hidden-test alignment; serial had simpler context flow but fewer canonical details.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel combined upstream-derived Flasky source behavior with parent patches for packaging, exports, API additions, and test-aligned details.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial created a custom implementation in large local patches and filled the project tree without adopting the canonical test suite.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's implementation path was reference-backed and evaluator-aligned; serial's path was internally coherent but more approximate against canonical Flasky expectations.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel child results returned to the parent, including the config/templates child final handoff, and the parent used them after inspection.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had no child lifecycle; all results were local command outcomes and final self-report from one agent.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had a completed child-result lifecycle with parent uptake; serial had no result-join risk but also no independent canonical handoff.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel suffered a real shared-workspace overlap: a side agent touched the implementation workspace, and the parent paused to inspect file and source state before continuing.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial had one actor writing one workspace, and protocol validation recorded no delegation or parallel use.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel had an adverse coordination episode in shared state, but it reconciled the issue; serial avoided this class of risk entirely.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel repeatedly ran the Flasky-style suite and reached 34 passed with one skipped before official evaluation passed 34 of 34.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial ran compileall and smoke checks for major flows and APIs, but did not run the canonical Flasky suite before closure.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel's verification was closer to evaluator expectations; serial's smoke checks missed five official cases.

comparison_dimensions.parallel_summary: Parallel used several child agents and many tool calls but closed with a verified passing implementation and no timeout.
comparison_dimensions.serial_summary: Serial used fewer resources and no subagents, also no timeout, but closed after smoke checks with official failures remaining.
comparison_dimensions.difference: Parallel spent more coordination and verification budget to reach canonical correctness; serial was simpler and cheaper but closed with less acceptance coverage.

outcome_analysis.explanation: The current official records are discordant: parallel passed 34 of 34 while serial passed 29 of 34. The supported process difference is that parallel used child-agent reference gathering and reference-backed tests to reproduce canonical Flasky behavior, then reconciled workspace overlap and verified with a Flasky-style suite. Serial built a functional Flasky-like project from scratch and smoke-tested important flows, but did not run the canonical suite or capture all evaluator-sensitive exact strings, payloads, and route/model details.
parallel_contributors: Reference children supplied canonical Flasky app, config, template, API, and model expectations.
The parent used a local Flasky-style suite and reached 34 passed with 1 skipped before closure.
The parent noticed shared-workspace overlap and inspected it rather than blindly accepting side-agent edits.
serial_contributors: Serial built from scratch with a broad custom implementation rather than adopting canonical Flasky source and tests.
Serial local verification was smoke-level and compile-level, not the canonical 34-test Flasky suite.
Serial closed after targeted checks even though the later official evaluation showed five failed cases.
ordinary_implementation_differences: Serial's custom route, template, API payload, and model details were less canonical despite covering the main feature categories.
Parallel included a bundled Flasky-style test suite that exercised exact behaviors serial did not test.
outcome_analysis.causal_scope: supported comparative contributors, not an exclusive root cause
